Bzip2 compression format, ported from bz2.go (extension ".bz2").

Backend is our own bz2f (BWT + MTF + Huffman, zero-copy in, reusable output buffers): no external compression dependency. Header "BZh" plus block-size digit; per-block and combined CRCs verified.

Bz2 = object
  compressionLevel*: int     ## 0 means DefaultCompression (6); 1..9 select up to 100k..900k RLE1 bytes per block
